messages:
Jordan (PM): Quick Q1 roadmap huddle — proposing we prioritize three Hosted API bets for the quarter: 1) Embeddings: target 2x median latency drop for batch calls and ~40% token cost improvement for typical search workloads; 2) Chat: streaming stability and function-calling parity with lower p99 latency; 3) Rerank: improve top-k accuracy on long-context queries and offer an SLA tier for a few customers. Looking for quick thumbs and any major blockers. @Priya @Marco @Ava @Riley

Priya (Eng): +1. Embeddings perf is feasible but depends on batching/kernel selection work. Need ~4 sprints of infra changes.

Marco (ML): Re rerank: we can get accuracy gains via fine-tuning + distillation but watch cost. Also for embeddings quantization looks promising (int8 + KV-cache tweaks). I'll sketch eval plan.

Ava (Product): Can we map each bet to 1) customer scenario, 2) launch guardrails, 3) canary criteria? I want minimal API surface changes for Q1.

Riley (Design): For chat streaming, UX safe-fallback is important — plan for clear partial response states and retry indicator. Minimal API change = prefer opt-in streaming flag.

Sam (Customer): From our side (search infra), embeddings latency and cost are huge. If you can show 30-40% cost improvement with same recall we'll sign up for the canary.

Marco (ML): For eval plan: propose offline holdout + 3 live canary customers. Metrics: recall@10, nDCG, generation latency delta, and failure rate. Thresholds: recall delta >= +3% for rerank; embeddings quality within ±1% of baseline.

Jordan (PM): Drafting acceptance criteria — paste below:

```
Embeddings acceptance criteria:
- median batch latency <= target (current / 2) on benchmark workload
- 30-40% lower per-token cost on typical search pipeline
- quality: cosine-recall@10 within -1% of baseline or better
- production canary with 3 customers for 2 weeks, no P0 regressions

Chat streaming acceptance criteria:
- streaming p99 latency <= current p99 * 0.8 under 95th percentile load
- function-calling parity for top-3 integrations
- fallback semantics defined + UX banner for partial responses
- automated smoke tests + synthetic load during canary

Rerank acceptance criteria:
- top-k nDCG uplift >= 3% on labeled eval set
- end-to-end tail latency within SLA for dedicated customers
- canary with one high-volume partner, rollback window defined
```

Priya (Eng): That's a solid start. Note: embedding cost wins rely on batching + KV cache persistence. Need infra owner and two infra tickets (batch scheduler, cache eviction tuning).

Marco (ML): I'll own the eval harness + tuning experiments. ETA for first experiments: 3 weeks.

Ava (Product): Suggest prioritization order: Embeddings -> Chat streaming -> Rerank. Embeddings gives fastest ROI for self-serve and sales motion.

Priya (Eng): Agree on order. Minor ask: can we reserve 1 week of oncall for the canary to handle unexpected regressions?

ops-bot: Deploy window scheduled: 2026-02-10 01:00–05:00 UTC (rolling). Canary flag enabled for 3 customers.

Jordan (PM): Next steps: 1) Priya to open infra epics and assign owners; 2) Marco to publish eval plan and initial numbers in #eng-ml by next Friday; 3) Ava to line up canary partners and write launch communication. I'll create the roadmap slice doc and OKR mapping today.

Riley (Design): I'll prepare the minimal UX copy and fallback states, deliverables by end of sprint.

Sam (Customer): Happy to be a canary for embeddings. Ping me when you have the contract/ops checklist.

Jordan (PM): Great — please react with :thumbsup: if you agree with prioritization and owners. If no objections by EOD Friday, we'll lock this into the Q1 plan.

Priya (Eng): :thumbsup:

Marco (ML): :thumbsup:

Ava (Product): :thumbsup:
